summary.relationship: 902 is the Platform Matrix denominator: estimated Vitest/CLI tests across 12 modules (MASTER_MODULE_INVENTORY). It is not the live Postgres RPC battery. The Live Database tab lists 38 interactive probes that call admin_run_test_case. Only 25 probes had explicit SQL CASE branches in 00115; the remaining 13 UI IDs previously hit the ELSE auto-pass bug (fixed in draft 00261 as NOT_IMPLEMENTED). After 00261, several of the 25 branches return BLOCKED when they only perform schema/fixture probes misaligned with E2E labels.
